title: Free representable module sheaves are etale extensions by zero
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $W$ an object of its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, with sheaves encoded as $\operatorname{Sheaf}(X_{\mathrm{et}},\operatorname{ModuleCat}\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Write $P_W$ for the sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] of the presheaf $V\mapsto\Lambda^{(\operatorname{Hom}_X(V,W))}$, with restriction induced by precomposition. There is an isomorphism $P_W\cong j_{W!}\underline{\Lambda}_{W}$, where $j_{W!}$ is etale extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension] and $\underline{\Lambda}_W$ is the constant rank-one module sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. No quasi-compactness, affineness, separatedness, or finiteness of $\Lambda$ is assumed.

proof.text: The free-forgetful adjunction for ModuleCat, whiskered over the site, and ulift Yoneda identify presheaf maps from the free representable with sections of F on W. Compose with sheafificationAdjunction to obtain the natural equivalence Hom(P_W,F) ≃ F(W). This is sectionEquiv in Lean.

The etale extension-by-zero/pullback adjunction, followed by upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction, identifies Hom(j_! constant Λ,F) with Hom(constant Λ,F restricted to W). The constant-sheaf adjunction evaluates at the terminal etale W-object (W,id). The restriction there is F evaluated at the localization image of (W,id), canonically isomorphic to W. Finally linear maps Λ → F(W) are identified with F(W) by evaluation at 1. This is shriekSectionEquiv in Lean.

Both equivalences commute with postcomposition. For the second, use naturality of the pullback/restriction comparison, naturality of the constant-sheaf adjunction, and naturality of F→G along the inverse of the localization-terminal isomorphism. Combine the equivalences and apply Coyoneda.ext to obtain the isomorphism.
